decision: Returning arms no longer invalidate narrowing on continuing paths. A context-and-target-depth log distinguishes escaping loop jumps from contained jumps without rescanning checked ASTs. Definite optional/union field assignments establish a member fact regardless of whether unrelated guards were checked earlier.
reference: Reviewed Sloppy compiler/check.jo renarrow at 237c46ad1d85d4ab83aedc79a2b245034fe3bf00. Dewy uses checked jump targets rather than an AST jump scan, preserving labeled nested-loop exits and ignoring other function/closure contexts.
optional_compatibility: Explicit coalescing, unwrapping, if-let and loop-let can recover the underlying optional view after narrowing. Nonoptional operands still fail. Dewy diagnostics recommend is?none rather than unsupported Jo postfix-unwrapping syntax.

validation.capture_scope: After the full suite, added independent-private and explicit-shared capture cases and reran the four recursive value batches (native/web, default/release). Compiler sources were unchanged.

caught_compatibility_failure: The initial full run stopped after 4488 passing checks because the pinned optionals fixture used ?? after an assignment now known to hold a string. Recovering the optional view fixes that regression; focused optional checks and the complete independent-bootstrap suite now pass.

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

runtime_proof.scope: Fresh artifact and checksum checks for all twelve existing kernels; seven paired timing samples only for workloads whose code changed.

artifact_proof.sample_order: Rotating positions and direction; identical artifacts share explicitly labeled samples when enabled.

limits: Native 64-bit host. Warm filesystem caches; one build per binary.

String equality uses separately allocated payloads; C uses pointer/length pairs and libc memcmp, Dewy uses runtime strings.

Thread CPU timing excludes descheduling, but CPU frequency and cache contention still matter.
